unary_response_complete: send a unary response and complete the gRPC server-side RPC call
stream_response: send a streaming response message to the client during a server-streaming RPC
stream_response_complete: complete a server-streaming RPC after sending all response messages
send_initial_metadata: send initial metadata to the client at the start of an RPC call
application_cancel: cancel an active gRPC RPC from the server-side application
